description: This file handles WebPA parameter request processing, including get and set operations, interacting with data models, host interface handlers, and RBUS for remote parameter management.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values for given parameter names, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Sets parameter values based on provided ParamVal array.

methods.name: ensureRbusHandle
methods.description: Initializes RBUS handle if not already initialized.

methods.name: getRbusDataTypefromWebPA
methods.description: Maps WAL_DATA_TYPE to RBUS data type.

methods.name: mapRbusDataTypeToWebPA
methods.description: Maps RBUS data type to WebPA WDMP_DATA_TYPE.

methods.name: rbusGetParamInfo
methods.description: Retrieves parameter info from RBUS, handling wildcards.

methods.name: GetParamInfo
methods.description: Internal function to get parameter info, handling wildcards and data model.

methods.name: SetParamInfo
methods.description: Internal function to set parameter info, interacting with data model or RBUS.

methods.name: isWildCardParam
methods.description: Checks if parameter name ends with '.' indicating wildcard.

methods.name: converttohostIfType
methods.description: Converts string data type to hostIf_ParamType_t enum.
